agentStop.bash: agentflow stop-gate || { r=${AGENTFLOW_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}}; if [ -z "$r" ]; then r=$(pwd -P); while [ -n "$r" ] && [ "$r" != / ] && [ ! -f "$r/.agent/plan.lock.json" ] && [ ! -e "$r/.git" ] && [ ! -L "$r/.git" ]; do r=${r%/*}; r=${r:-/}; done; fi; if [ -f "$r/.agent/plan.lock.json" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"block","reason":"agentflow stop-gate could not run. Install or upgrade agentflow-proof to 1.9.0 or later so the agentflow command is on PATH, then try to stop again."}'; else printf '{}\n'; fi; }
agentStop.powershell: if (Get-Command agentflow -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { agentflow stop-gate; if ($?) { exit 0 } }; $r = $env:AGENTFLOW_ROOT; if (!$r) { $r = $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR }; if (!$r) { $d = Get-Item -LiteralPath .; while ($d.Parent -and !(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d.FullName ".agent/plan.lock.json") -PathType Leaf) -and !(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d.FullName ".git"))) { $d = $d.Parent }; $r = $d.FullName }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $r ".agent/plan.lock.json") -PathType Leaf) { '{"decision":"block","reason":"agentflow stop-gate could not run. Install or upgrade agentflow-proof to 1.9.0 or later so the agentflow command is on PATH, then try to stop again."}' } else { '{}' }; exit 0
